name: Chunked Voxel Mesh Generation with Face Culling and Quad Expansion
definition: A voxel meshing algorithm that processes a 3D chunk of voxels to generate triangle strips for visible faces. It uses neighbor chunk references to determine visibility across chunk boundaries, expands contiguous faces into quads to reduce vertex count, and packs vertex attributes into a single integer per vertex for compact storage.
summary: Chunked Voxel Mesh Generation with Face Culling and Quad Expansion is a surface extraction algorithm that reduces draw calls by merging coplanar faces into quads and handling neighbor chunk references for visibility.
